Public bundle note: only minified runtime/worker, CMaps, fonts and licenses are included. Non-minified builds from the full engineering candidate are intentionally omitted.

Mozilla PDF.js (pdfjs-dist)
Selected Compatible Patched Version: 4.10.38 (Not claimed as upstream latest release)
Upstream Package Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-4.10.38.tgz (Mozilla GitHub: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v4.10.38)
License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE file in this directory)
Copyright 2024 Mozilla Foundation

Version Selection & Security Rationale:
- Mozilla Security Advisory GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq (CVE-2024-4367, font matrix arbitrary code execution) affects pdfjs-dist <= 4.1.392 and is patched in >= 4.2.67.
- Version 4.10.38 is selected as a compatible, security-patched 4.x release whose native ESM build (.mjs) works directly with local loopback HTTP serving and Node.js v22 test runners without bundler transpilation.

  - Foxit Fonts: Foxit License (see standard_fonts/LICENSE_FOXIT)

Supply-Chain Verification Boundary Note:
- Automated unit tests in this repository verify local file existence, size thresholds, version string ("4.10.38"), and PDF parsing behavior.
- In-repo NOTICE metadata, file size checks, and version strings are NOT a substitute for independent upstream tarball byte-by-byte verification. Independent QA may compare the above SHA-256 digests directly against an independently fetched upstream pdfjs-dist@4.10.38 tarball.
